words: Re-pinned seven stale staged members of three function entries in the source map: three in irpt-cot-account-return-daily-lambda (the Cottonwood adapter, lib/trading_calendar.py and infra/logic/registry/legacy_addresses.json), one in irpt-49f-reporting-publish-lambda (lib/trading_calendar.py) and three in irpt-cot-reporting-publish-lambda (the reporting-publish publisher.py, org/standards/IRPT_DASHBD_SERIES_CONTRACT.json and lib/trading_calendar.py). Each re-pinned member takes as pin the last commit at HEAD that changed its file and as sha256 the file's bytes at HEAD, which equal the bytes at that pin. Every other member, key, entry and top-level key stays byte-identical, and no member was added or removed. No deployed field moved: the artifact hashes, the deployed code hash, the last deployed commit and time, and recorded_by are unchanged. The handler and publisher of the 49 Financial publish entry are source-directory files, not staged members, so no pin moved for them. The checker's AC1 and AC2 pass on this tree, and the build-only package of each entry equals its sources. Not proven: nothing is built for upload, uploaded or deployed, and a pinned file edited by another seat after this commit makes its entry stale again.
